verdict.rationale: Cooley's practice page says an S-1 draft can be produced in minutes and then updated as transaction terms change "with a few simple prompts," which is a prompt-driven natural-language workflow. Cooley AI is described as helping the firm's lawyers rather than as a client-operated interface, and the Cooley GO generators appear to be form-based, so it is unclear whether users themselves can issue natural-language commands. Missing for 10: evidence of a user-facing natural-language interface for Cooley GO or other client tools, documentation of how prompts work, coverage beyond S-1 drafting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
